claims.value: A 21B general-purpose reasoning model trained from scratch using synthetic and public datasets for SFT, followed by RLOO with model-based and rule-based rewards.
claims.evidence: Reka Flash 3 is a 21B general-purpose reasoning model that was trained from scratch.
For multi-round conversations, it is recommended to drop the reasoning traces in the previous assistant round to save tokens for the model to think.
Reka Flash 3 uses cl100k_base tokenizer and adds no additional special tokens.
Generation should stop on seeing the string `<sep>` or seeing the special token `</reasoning>`.
The model often thinks in English when prompted with questions in non-English languages.
